rows.grounds: compound expressing a measure of three-quarters (four parts minus one quarter)
fused token containing dharātalam (earth-level) and udāhṛtam (declared); internal boundary not split

items.question: What proportional measure is prescribed for the ground level in this construction?
premises: The ground level (dharātala) is the element being specified.
Its measure is prescribed as a fourth part less by one quarter.
This measure is authoritatively declared in the text.
items.inference: Therefore the ground level is prescribed to measure three-quarters of the relevant unit.
uncertainties: The exact reference unit for the three-quarter measure depends on the preceding verses' context.
items.plain_english: But the ground level is declared to be three-quarters in measure.
